name: debug_pixel_baseline_tiny
scope: PIXEL_BASELINE_FEASIBILITY only. Question: can model inputs be built from rendered pixels and raw captions alone, does the same-data hard-negative baseline train on them, and can binding-necessary cases be evaluated without giving the model any ground truth. Not a test of the edit loss, not natural images, no test split.
prior_exposure: smoke_v0 evaluated data_v0 test splits (subsampled) and showed the content-only shortcut; this stage uses data_v1 (fresh seed, orbit-level split) and only its train/dev panels.

panel.selection_rule: first N groups in generation order (kinds cycle binding, attribute, object, relation); never chosen by model performance
panel.test_splits: NOT_RUN: not rendered, not encoded, not evaluated

subsets.primary_for_panel: binding_necessary: every op kind in {binding, relation} (metadata rule)

input.image: pixel_render.render(scene, render_seed) -> 224x224 RGB -> frozen CLIP tokens (50 x 512)
input.text: raw caption string -> frozen CLIP per-token states (L x 512)
input.bridge: per-dimension standardization of image and of text tokens with TRAIN-panel statistics only

head.class: TorchFactorizedHead (torch bridge of FactorizedHead; same init and math)

fit_sanity.pass_rule: group score on the same 16 train groups >= 0.75

trains_rule: mean over seeds of (final-step task loss / step-1 task loss) <= 0.7

gradient_ratio.where: the first training batch of each seed (train panel only)
gradient_ratio.quantity: ||grad L_edit|| / ||grad L_task|| at lambda = 1, tau_eq = 0.1; reported only, not read as utility

controls: random scorer: analytic chance and Monte-Carlo mean over 500 draws on the dev panel
trained pixel head, content-only and binding-only channels
trained pixel head with dev images shuffled across groups; with dev captions shuffled across groups
image-only logistic regression on pooled CLIP image features; text-only n-gram logistic regression (both fit on the train panel)
oracle-object-token control: v0 metadata proxy tokens, same head class, same training setting and seeds

diagnostics.nuisance_ratio: dev: median CLIP pooled cosine distance between the two group members / median distance between two renders (different seeds) of the same member, per op kind
diagnostics.content_residual: dev binding-necessary groups rendered with ONE shared seed: ||c(I1) - c(I0)|| / ||c(I0)|| of the trained pixel head (v0 proxy: exactly 0 by construction)
diagnostics.base_vs_edited_detectability: pooled-image logistic regression, train panel -> dev panel AUC with bootstrap CI (small n: weak evidence either way)
diagnostics.ties: fraction of groups with any tied comparison (1e-9 relative tolerance)
diagnostics.pair_auc: threshold-free; pair accuracy at a calibrated threshold is NOT_RUN (no calibration panel in this stage)

decision_rules.Q1_pixel_input_and_eval_path: PASS iff renderer decode mismatches = 0 on every rendered panel image, all features finite with nonzero variance, oracle control = 1.0 on every dev metric, every planned scorer produced every cell, and the provenance-guard test passes in the final test run
decision_rules.Q2_baseline_trains: PASS iff fit_sanity pass_rule and trains_rule hold
decision_rules.Q2_bottleneck_reading: descriptive only: compare train fit, dev binding-necessary scores, the oracle-token control and the nuisance ratio; no significance claims (n = 16 binding-necessary dev groups)
decision_rules.Q3_binding_necessary_evaluable: PASS iff >= 12 binding-necessary dev groups are scored from pixel/caption inputs only, the oracle control is 1.0 on them, and the shuffle and blind controls are reported with pair AUC, ties and chance levels

caps.note: install and checkpoint download are recorded separately (runs/install_pixel_v1_*, runs/fetch_encoder_*)

not_run: pair accuracy at a calibrated threshold
supervision_disclosure: labels and false-negative masks come from oracle truth on metadata; the hard negative is the group partner (metadata pairing). No op kind, base/edited flag, held-out flag, scene ID or parser output enters any model input.
purpose: DEBUG plumbing run on a tiny panel; results meaningless
